contextual_execution_identity.rule: The identity symbol is invocation-contextual. It derives direction_grid_sha256 and remap_plan_sha256 from validated caller inputs and returns the same canonical JSON UTF-8 identity carried by trajectory and batch results for that invocation.

native_payload_and_installation_evidence.rule: The runtime field is a static logical payload identifier analogous to the scalar-v1 identifier. The exact installed wheel SHA-256 is recorded only in the immutable LOCAL-01 evidence receipt and is never read from mutable state or serialized as a per-call runtime identity field.

carrier_policy.input_screen_rule: Reject when the absolute maximum packed-component leakage from the screen projection exceeds 1e-10; no input projection is permitted.
carrier_policy.realizability_rule: Use the final donor's existing per-node realizability rule with tolerance 1e-10: for positive intensity I use absolute tolerance 1e-10*I, otherwise use 1e-10. Reject negative coherency eigenvalues below minus that tolerance.

geometry_receipts.rule: Use the versioned canonical byte codecs and receipt hash chain in V2_PUBLIC_MAPPING.json. Every accepted outer step has one receipt; no aggregate, codec, or chain field is inferred by a caller.

diagnostics.rule: For each accepted outer step, raw_pre_projection_screen_leakage is measured on the complete raw step state immediately before the final screen projection, and post_projection_screen_leakage is measured on the stored accepted state immediately after that projection.

batch_failure_contract.rule: 0 is the only success member_status. 1 is the only isolated typed-member-failure member_status. Common schema, grid, plan, and route failures raise the existing whole-call exception; member_error_code carries the exact finite code table in V2_PUBLIC_MAPPING.json.

required_local_proof: The local implementation must prove the contextual identity exactly matches the identity carried in a trajectory and batch generated from identical directions, weights, and remap_plan.
The local implementation must prove an identity call cannot obtain dynamic plan/grid values from mutable process-global state.
The local implementation must prove deterministic geometry receipt bytes and hash-chain heads against fixed test vectors.
The local implementation must prove Reject-mode carrier failure, raw/post diagnostic timing, common-call failure, and isolated member failure through PyO3.
The exact installed wheel SHA-256 must be recorded in evidence and must not occur in a runtime execution_identity value.
